* 🔴 User stated rule: Partner Jonah must sign off on all vendor contracts before any deposit is paid.
* 🔴 User stated current guest count is 112 (updated from 140).
* 🟡 Wedding design & decor: Lavender/sage ceremony backdrop, eucalyptus & white roses arch (with portable greenhouse backup tent $1,200), custom silver monogram cake topper, 100 amber LED lights ($650).
* 🟡 Catering & desserts: Culinary Creations catering, vegan dessert menu ($45/guest), Sweet Symphony vegan chocolate mousse cake ($950), dessert tasting arranged with Savor/Sweet Horizon.
* 🟡 Entertainment & music: Live acoustic band (Aug 20), Eternal Strings string quartet ($2,200), Nightfall DJ ($2,800), Rhythm & Beats DJ ($1,200), sunset cocktail playlist.

</observations>

- Primary: Finding a venue that can accommodate a moonlit outdoor ceremony and adjusting event plans for the 112 guest count.
</current-task>
